draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.96, the 179th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 20th of 29 at CB. He went 80th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (179th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 10 passes defended in 2024, 4th of 29 CBs in his class with stats.
